_about: Business -> More work (2026-11-17, owner: 'find more work'). Ways to make money next to the bots, ranked. The research and every source: research/writeups/more-work-2026-11-17.md. Dollar figures are beginner ESTIMATES from mostly vendor and review blogs, not promises. work.js draws this with textContent only.
first: Today, 10 min on the PC: put your agency name, phone, email, postal address and city in agency/config.json, then double-click tools/bat/AGENCY_DAY.bat. You get today's leads, demo sites and every script.
Tomorrow, 2-4 pm: 10 calls and 5 walk-ins with the short scripts below. Anyone who says 'we already have a website' gets the $149 Google profile fix offer.
Only if you need cash in the next 2 weeks: sign up for DoorDash as a floor. Otherwise put those hours into the agency: it pays far more per hour once it sells.

ideas.name: Websites for local shops (the agency)
ideas.cost: $0 (free hosting; the client pays for the domain)
ideas.claude: Finds the leads, builds a demo site before you call, writes the pitch, the email and the final site.
ideas.why: 17% of US small businesses still have no website. A one-page site from a freelancer costs $500-$1,500, so $1,500 is a fair price (and $149 a month with nothing upfront is an easy yes). Crowded online, far less in person in your own town. The call rates are guesses until you count your own.
ideas.niche: Tip: pick one trade for a month (roofers, HVAC, plumbers, dentists, auto repair). They earn more per job, so the Call engine ($500 + $299 a month) fits them, and one script fits all of them.
steps: Fill agency/config.json, run tools/bat/AGENCY_DAY.bat
15 contacts a weekday: 10 calls, 5 walk-ins or DMs
Follow up once after 2-3 days, then stop

ideas.name: Google Business Profile setup and fix
ideas.usd_month: $150-$600 (1-4 fixes at $149, a few at $49 a month)
ideas.claude: Writes the description, services, weekly posts and review replies; checks the profile against a list.
ideas.why: Same shops, same visit: it is the offer for the ones who already have a website. Fiverr sells it for $50-$200 and local freelancers for $300-$800. The owner stays the owner: you are only added as a Manager. Never write or buy reviews (the FTC banned fake reviews in 2024).
steps: Add 'Google profile fix $149' to your walk-in and call answers
Do your first one free for a shop you know, take before/after shots
Sell $49 a month for 4 posts and review replies

ideas.name: Small freelance jobs, Claude-assisted (Upwork / Fiverr)
ideas.cost: $0 to join; Upwork proposals cost a few dollars of Connects; fees 10-20%
ideas.claude: Does most of the work: spreadsheet formulas and clean-ups, data entry, TradingView Pine Script tweaks you can test for free.
ideas.why: Writing, logos and social media gigs are flooded, and a study of Upwork found writing jobs and pay fell after ChatGPT. A narrow lane you know (trading spreadsheets, Pine Script indicators) is less crowded. Check every delivery yourself and never claim a skill you cannot back.
steps: One Upwork profile for one lane: 'Google Sheets and Excel fixes'
Send 3 short proposals a day to small fixed-price jobs
Ask every happy client for a review: the first 5 reviews are the hard part

ideas.name: DoorDash / Uber Eats as the floor
ideas.usd_month: $400-$700 at 10 h a week ($10-$18 an hour after gas)
ideas.cost: $0 with your own car (check your insurance)
ideas.claude: Little: picks the busy hours and keeps the mileage log for taxes.
ideas.why: The only money here that is sure from week 1. It does not grow, wears the car, and costs gas and taxes (30-40% of gross).
steps: Sign up in the Dasher app (background check takes days)
Drive only the dinner rush, Fri-Sun
Log every mile: it lowers your tax

ideas.name: AI training tasks (DataAnnotation, Outlier)
ideas.usd_month: $100-$600 at 5 h a week, when there is work
ideas.claude: None on the tasks: the platforms ban AI answers and close accounts that use them.
ideas.why: Real companies paying $15-$25 an hour for general tasks, but work comes and goes, the entry test is one try, and pay glitches are reported. Fake 'AI trainer' recruiters who ask for a fee are a scam.
steps: Apply on the platform's own site, never through a text or a recruiter
Take the entry test slowly, once
Treat it as extra, not as a plan

ideas.name: Reselling (Facebook Marketplace flips)
ideas.cost: $100-$300 to buy the first items; a car helps
ideas.claude: Prices from sold listings, writes the listings, spots good buys in photos.
ideas.why: Real, but slow and crowded, and it needs money up front. Furniture gives the best margin ($100-$400 a piece). Meet in public, take cash or the app's own payment.
steps: Flip what you already own first
Buy only items you have seen sell for 2x the price
Track profit after gas, not sales

ideas.name: Local service arbitrage (sell jobs, pay a crew)
ideas.cost: $800-$2,500 a month of ads, or door knocking
ideas.claude: Writes the ads and the quotes.
ideas.why: Not free and not this week: leads cost $30-$65 each on Google, a house wash pays the crew about $300, so your slice is thin, and the customer's complaints are yours.
steps: Skip until the agency pays
Then sell it to your web clients' trades
Never take money before a crew has agreed the job

ideas.name: Paid surveys and user testing (Prolific)
ideas.claude: None: answers must be your own.
ideas.why: Prolific makes researchers pay at least $8 an hour ($12 suggested), but you can only take the studies you qualify for. Most survey apps pay $1-$3 an hour in points.
steps: Prolific only (skip points apps)
Fill the profile fully: more studies match
Cash out at $6

plan.goal: $1,000+ in 30 days = 1 Starter site ($1,500 + $79 a month), or 2 Call engines ($500 + $299 a month each).
ladder: $149 one time: the door-opener for shops that already have a site
$1,500 + $79 a month (or $149 a month for 12 months, nothing upfront): up to 5 pages, the site they saw
$500 + $299 a month: Google profile, review requests, every review answered (3-month minimum)
$100 off the setup for a written review and the right to show their site
plan.pace: 15 contacts a weekday (10 calls, 5 walk-ins or DMs), about 1.5 h. With the machine's guesses (1 in 4 calls reaches the owner, 1 in 2 agree to look, 1 in 4 who look buy) one sale takes about 32 contacts; 300 contacts in 20 days leaves a 3x margin, because those guesses are not proven yet.
weeks: Settings, first batch, 75 contacts. Goal: 8 people say 'send it'.
Follow up once with everyone from week 1, 75 new contacts. Goal: the first yes.
75 contacts; offer the $149 fix to everyone with a site; ask client 1 who else needs one.
75 contacts; yes 2 and 3. Put your real call numbers into agency/pricing.json.
say: Hi, is the owner in? I'm (name), I make websites for shops here in (city). I noticed you don't have a website I could find, so I built you a free preview. Can I show you on my phone? It takes 30 seconds. If you like it, it's $1,500 and $79 a month, or $149 a month with nothing upfront. I'll leave this page with the link.
Hi! I'm (name), a local web designer in (city). I made (business) a free preview website: (link). No cost to look. If you like it, I can make it yours this week. Want the details?

Hi, it's (name). Did you get a chance to look at the preview for (business)? I can switch it on with your logo and photos in 2 days: $1,500 to start (or $149 a month, nothing upfront), $79 a month care plan, cancel any time. Want me to go ahead, or should I take it down?
$1,500 to set it up, then $79 a month for hosting and small changes (a 12-month care plan), or $149 a month for 12 months with nothing upfront.
plan.rules: Take the setup fee before the site goes live (the billing kit makes the invoice). Demos: Netlify's free plan allows about 20 a month, after that drop them on Cloudflare Pages (free). One message, one follow-up, then stop. Put 30% of every payment in the tax pot.

scams: Apps or 'jobs' that want a deposit, often crypto, before you can earn. Task scams took $220M in the first half of 2024 alone (FTC).
Job offers by text or WhatsApp
Real employers do not recruit you out of the blue on a chat app.
Forwarding packages or moving money for someone: you become the money mule, and it is a crime.
A buyer pays too much and asks for the difference back. The first payment bounces later.
Writing or buying reviews is banned by the FTC (2024) with fines per review.
Dropshipping stores, 'done for you' shops, 'copy and paste $500 a day': the seller earns from the course, not you.
Any 'opportunity' you pay to join or must recruit friends into.
$1-$3 an hour paid in points, and some ask for a fee to 'upgrade'.
sources: Clutch: 17% of small businesses have no website (2025)
Hui, Reshef, Zhou (WashU): ChatGPT cut Upwork writing jobs 2%, pay 5.2%
